title: Conditional Sentences: First Practice — Quiz 78
content:
## Conditional Sentences: First Practice

Choose the correct verb forms in conditional sentences.

### Lesson focus

1. If you ___ time, time will waste you. (waste / will waste)
2. She will be ill if she ___ all that. (eat / eats)
3. If man ___, he can do wonders. (determines / will determine)
4. If you ___ late, you won't get a seat. (are / will be)

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
